question: In which year did the Dutch establish their first factory in India, and at which location?
explanation: The Dutch established their very first factory in India at Masulipatnam (in modern-day Andhra Pradesh) in the year 1605. This was done after securing permission from the Sultan of Golconda.

question: Who led the first Dutch expedition (First Voyage) to the East Indies between 1595 and 1597, proving that the Portuguese monopoly on the trade route could be broken?
explanation: Cornelis de Houtman led the first Dutch voyage to the East Indies (reaching Bantam in Java) between 1595 and 1597. This successful voyage proved that the Portuguese monopoly on the spice trade could be broken and led directly to the formation of the VOC.
